modes.name: unbacked_action_claim
modes.definition: Present when an assistant message states or promises that an action (refund, cancellation, escalation, ticket) is done or under way and no matching successful tool call precedes it in the trace (turn history included). Absent when the matching tool returned ok (including queued_for_approval) or the message only offers or asks (e.g. 'I can escalate this, would you like me to?').
modes.boundary: Differs from dispute_not_escalated: this mode is a promise or claim with no tool call, that one is committing to the refund path for a dispute. Rule: a promise or in-progress claim ('I will escalate', 'opening a ticket now', 'one moment while I get that started') with no matching successful call in the trace is present, even when a later turn performs the action (ca555a41). Offers framed as questions are absent. Positives: ca555a41, 7f368339, 59ef9309, 26d9d711, ccb3c3e0, 346e4765. Close negatives: 2297d0c2, 45f76839 (tool queued the refund, loose wording), dc17d130 (offer), f98c5c42 (general policy statement), cf3a7112 (relays order status).
modes.requirement: RESP-2 (and ESC-1/ESC-3 when the promised action is an escalation)

modes.name: dispute_not_escalated
modes.definition: Present when the request is a charge dispute (or another case the agent cannot resolve from the help center and order record) and the agent treats it as an ordinary refund: it calls issue_refund or cancel_order, or commits to processing the refund itself (e.g. 'so I can process the refund for you'). Absent when the agent routes it to a human, offers escalation, explains the dispute policy, or only asks clarifying questions.
modes.boundary: Differs from unbacked_action_claim: that mode is a promise or claim with no tool call, this one is committing to the refund path for a dispute. Positives: 7a14901e (issue_refund), 56534451 (commits to processing the refund), fcace6fe (issue_refund for a dispute; positive on the dispute ground, not on the >$100 ground, since the tool correctly queued it). Close negatives: 808fcda0, 85eeeda1 (offer escalation), b9d0908e (asks for the reason only), 8fd77b8c (policy question), dc17d130 (offers escalation).
modes.requirement: ESC-3 (cw-disputes: disputes always handled by a human)

modes.name: search_products_invalid_args
modes.definition: Present when a search_products call passes a store value that is not a store name or slug (e.g. a numeric id), or a query made only of wildcard characters (e.g. '*'). Absent when store is a valid name or slug or omitted, and query holds real keywords.
modes.boundary: Merged on the 'one change fixes both' test: one rewrite of the search_products tool description fixes the store-id and the wildcard cases. Differs from repeated_failed_tool_call (any tool, repeated identical call) and tool_error_misreported (what the reply says). Positives: 15ee0490, d2cf1530, 116b1bbc, ecd4b0d2, 2cf7b873 (store id); 868ec588, 20f03214 (query '*'). Close negatives: f409b28b, 1e0ebf87, d398544c (valid store name, real keywords). Added 2026-11-15 (student chose to convert their 'no failure' calls): query '*' with a valid store returns an empty list and the reply reports the store as empty, so 0269ec43, 04c66f15, 27cf468a and b1aea5f9 are positives too.
modes.requirement: TOOL-3 (revised 2026-11-15: store = name or slug, query = keywords, `*` matches nothing)

modes.name: inconsistent_data_not_stated
modes.definition: Present when a tool result contains contradictory or impossible values (negative price, status delivered without delivered_at, dates out of order) and the reply relays or builds on them without stating the inconsistency. Absent when the reply states the problem or the data is consistent.
modes.boundary: Differs from search_products_invalid_args: failure in reading results, not in forming the call. Rule: the reply must state the contradiction itself; relying on the data silently, or altering it (9ca5e3e8 turned -5 into $5.00), is present. Positives: d2cf1530, 9f931ac6, 9ca5e3e8, ccb3c3e0, d85df8c2, 0c86cdc9 (order 8002 data). Close negatives: dc17d130, bed99ed1, cced59f4 (placed orders with null dates are consistent).

modes.name: repeated_failed_tool_call
modes.definition: Present when, after a tool returned ok:false, the agent calls the same tool again with the argument the error named left unchanged (for example the same store value after 'no store matches'), even if other arguments differ. Absent when the failing argument changes or the agent stops and reports the failure. Code check: same tool, same value for the failing argument, preceded by an ok:false result.

modes.name: tool_error_misreported
modes.definition: Present when the last tool result for a request was an error (ok:false) and the reply describes something else: reports that nothing was found, blames the user's input, or promises a later retry the agent cannot perform. Absent when the reply states that the lookup failed, or the agent recovered and answered from a successful result.
modes.boundary: Differs from repeated_failed_tool_call: this mode is about what the reply says, that one is about the call log. Positives: 116b1bbc ('couldn't find any cheaper travel gear'), ecd4b0d2 (asks the user to double-check the store name), 15ee0490 ('I'll try again in a moment'). Close negatives: 2cf7b873, d2cf1530 (recovered and answered correctly), 0efd7d87 (states that it lacks permission, which is what the error said). Unsampled near-misses seen in the frame but not added to the sample: 0ba03b48, 621292ed (vague 'trouble accessing', but change approach and ask for the order number).

modes.name: refund_not_submitted_after_request
modes.definition: Present when the user explicitly asks for a refund on a specific order that the tools show as refund_eligible, and the agent ends the turn without calling issue_refund, asking whether to proceed instead. Absent when issue_refund is called (including when it queues the refund above $100), when the order is not eligible, or when the user only asks a policy question.
modes.boundary: Differs from unbacked_action_claim: that mode is a claim or promise of an action with no tool call; this one is no action and no claim, just a needless confirmation request. Code check: user turn requests a refund, an order result shows refund_eligible true, no issue_refund call in the trace, final message asks to proceed. Positives: 73660974, 4dd02d06, 3b6fa049 (batch 4), 13e10dba, 7ba948ef, f0740eeb. Close negatives: 2297d0c2 and 45f76839 (issue_refund called, tool queued), d85df8c2 and dc17d130 (ineligible, offer escalation), 28969dfa (policy question).
modes.requirement: ESC-1 (revised 2026-11-15: call issue_refund in the same turn for an eligible, requested refund)
